truncation_path.historical_per_row_cutoff_statistics: NOT_RECORDED; deleted counts, deleted-row dot contributions, and cutoff maxima must be measured in the new diagnostic; do not infer them from prior summaries.
truncation_path.in_memory_cache: The builder uses a phase-keyed component_cache and the reused-vector workspace. This is in-memory reuse, not a disk functional store.
truncation_path.projection_conjugation: Combined projection values are conjugated when stored in FullspaceDtnModeFunctional; FullspaceDtnAction then computes np.dot(projection_values, source_values). Preserve this order exactly.
truncation_path.stage_1: Each x/y component PETSc vector is MPC-assembled, then _vec_nonzero_owned_entries retains entries with abs(value) > max(1e-30, 1e-13 * global_max_on_owned_support).
truncation_path.stage_2: _combine_owned_entries applies the coefficients, stable-sorts and sums duplicate rows, then independently retains abs(summed_value) > max(1e-30, 1e-13 * global_max_after_merge). Projection and coupling each use this merge cutoff.

interpretation_limits.MPC_conjugation_recovery_alternatives: Remain open; separate component cutoff, merged cutoff, MPC-dual vs direct full-primal, projection conjugation, mode normalization, saved-field reconstruction, and auxiliary recovery without presupposing any is causal.
